ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity distribution; approximately 90% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across the visible ventral plane contrasted against 10% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central region; black pigment mapping is confined to a continuous 10-25 pixel wide band along the trailing edge and expanding into solid dark zones at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees with a vertical depth roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the medial trailing edge; transitions to high-amplitude, irregular macro-serrations (jagged peaks) on the distal third of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward convexity; the upper margin of the lobes follows a smooth convex arc tapering to acute terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of dark, circular pixel clusters (3-7 pixel diameter) scattered across the mid-ventral surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, vertical low-contrast grey linear streaks detected on the inner quadrant of the left lobe and proximal to the peduncle interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular tissue loss/indentation on the distal tip of the left lobe; single dark focal lesion visible approximately 20 pixels below the vertex of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in trailing edge topography, where the right lobe distal margin exhibits significantly deeper and more irregular jaggedness compared to the left lobe margin.
